description: Reviewer role: read the author's answers, in the author's own words, straight off the run. This is where the interview reaches you — you do NOT need answers relayed as text, and you must not paraphrase a summary into the document when the verbatim answer is here. Each round carries `answered_by`: only `author` is attested, `reviewer` is your own transcription, and `null` means nobody has answered yet. Paged: follow `next_cursor` until there is none.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit to start at the beginning.

max_bytes.description: Byte budget for this page. Defaults to the server's ceiling.

only_answered.description: Skip rounds nobody has answered yet. Leave false while you are waiting, so you can see what is still outstanding.

name: get_answers
